title: The 360 isn't just an assessment. It's a foothold.
paragraphs: Our 360 process introduces you to your organization differently. Leaders who've been through one consistently say the same thing: they didn't expect it to go that deep.
Every engagement reaches the people around a leader — peers, direct reports, stakeholders — which means every 360 opens more doors than it starts with.

steps.stepTitle: We Interview the people around you
steps.stepBody: Peers, direct reports, and stakeholders — up to 12 people. Conducted by a Cadence coach. Confidential, qualitative, and built to surface what surveys can't.
Not a dashboard. A written account of how you're experienced —themes, patterns, and specific behaviours the data actually supports. Honest without being brutal.

steps.stepTitle: We debrief and build a path forward
steps.stepBody: A structured debrief with your coach, followed by a development plan grounded in what came out of the 360. Most leaders continue into coaching from here.
